variants.asks: a fold is a way. How many ways does a local have, and what moves them?
variants.leads: THE WAYS AT A LOCAL, a tick on: half a way for every meeting seen from each of l's lattice's edges, and a creation takes a way off every one of them that holds a fold - so they settle, at half as many again as the lattice's own.
variants.then: AND WHAT THEY ARE: the lattice's own ways and one for every fold.

steps.because: the rules, read as a line: every rule of the theory is a term, the reading having run each rule's program on a symbolic match and counted what it does to the population - what it makes, what it takes, what it carries, what a body puts in - so the line is what the rules come to as a crowd rather than a description of them. Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

derivation.because: ANNIHILATION contributes it: its body comes to -2 rays and -1 points of space, its quantifier makes it of degree 2 in the density across an edge, which is the facing factor, and its gates let through what they let through

rule /1 "Annihilation" | σ (x: 1 Edge{active}) => x.ANNIHILATE - -2 rays, -1 points of space. The reading follows the body down through the methods it calls, and the ledgers it moves are counted off the assignments it makes

steps.via: the ways at a local, a tick on
working: ANNIHILATION: \frac{1}{2} a fold on each of DEG_{0} of l's ways, 1 of them, at S^{-} - \frac{DEG_{0}·S^{-}}{2}
CREATION: -1 a fold on each of DEG of l's ways, \frac{\paren{DEG - DEG_{0}}}{DEG} of them, at S^{+} - -\paren{DEG - DEG_{0}}·S^{+}
steps.because: l's ways move one for one with its record, and the record is moved by the same rules, by the same shares: a meeting writes one fold on an edge of l's lattice, half of it seen from each of its ends, and a creation takes a fold off every one of l's ways that holds one - DEG_{0} + n_{f,l} - DEG_{0} of them. So the ways' line is written in the rules' own names, and it settles: the more ways l has, the more a creation takes back

derivation.because: the same rules, read on another ledger: every term that makes or takes a fold of the record does so at its own rate, through its own gates, and the count one firing moves is written on it. The constants are the same facts as on the population's line, filled in here the same way

derivation.via: the ways move with the record
derivation.because: the record at l is the only thing on the ways' line that moves, so the ways move by its slope in it - one way for every fold written, one fewer for every fold taken off

derivation.via: the record is the space held
working: a meeting: one point held, one fold written
a creation: `if folds[d] > 0` on each of DEG ways is n_{f} folds off; `if held.last != None` is n_{f} points back - the same record, twice
so s - n_{f} does not move: s = 1 + n_{f}, a local holds itself and one point per fold
the population's transport, \paren{\nabla n_{f}}·\nabla_{\hat{d}} with 1/(1+n_{f}) kept, is steered by that record
derivation.because: the same firings move both ledgers, and nothing is handed back by decree. ANNIHILATION folds a point into the hub and writes one fold on the way it came by: one held, one written. CREATION lights every exit and unfolds - and unfolding is gated twice on the same record: a fold comes off a way only `if folds[d] > 0`, and a point comes back only `if held.last != None`, and a hub holds one point per fold it wrote. Read as the shares they are, the ways that lose a fold number n_{f} in expectation and so do the points that come back: the hand-back is what the gates come to on aggregate, not a line in the rule. So the space a local holds and the record it keeps move together, tick for tick, and their difference does not move at all. Integrated, s - n_{f} is a constant, and it is one: a local holds itself and one point per fold. THAT IS WHERE THE POPULATION'S LINE STANDS ON THE SPACE: it never names s, but its transport leans on \nabla n_{f} and keeps 1/(1 + n_{f}) of a heading, and its room ahead \omega is the share of ways whose far point is still there - both are the space, read through the record

working: one match: 2 of l's ways, -1 a way
derivation.because: Annihilation at l, per way: its pattern narrows l to Edge\{active\}, which holds \frac{\rho·\tilde{\rho}}{2} of l's ways - its rate, what the pattern asked, and the ends it needs lit, l's own and the one across its edge. One match is 2 of l's ways and one firing takes 1 ray on each. So it takes \frac{\rho·\tilde{\rho}}{2} of l's ways a tick: written S^{-}: S for a rule, marked by what it does to the rays

working: one match: DEG of l's ways, 1 a way
derivation.because: Creation at l, per way: its pattern narrows l to Vertex\{neutral\}, which holds 1 - \rho of l's ways - its rate, what the pattern asked, and the ends it needs lit, l's own and the one across its edge. One match is DEG of l's ways and one firing lights 1 ray on each. So it lights 1 - \rho of l's ways a tick: written S^{+}: S for a rule, marked by what it does to the rays
